messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
Memory: one remembered fact per line, with the dates it held and the note that recorded it. An indented "earlier" line is a version of the fact above it that was later corrected.
- [decision] The image resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only, since storage for originals doubled in six months. (since 2026-03-17; source standup/atlas/2026-03-17)
- The Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the image resizer's owners. (since 2025-10-15; source standup/atlas/2025-10-15)
- The product catalog depends on the image resizer for thumbnails. (since 2025-04-14; source standup/cinder/2025-04-14)
- Team Dune observed that the image resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade. (since 2025-08-19; source standup/dune/2025-08-19-2)
- [decision] As of 2025-11-26, the image resizer is owned by the Atlas team, taking over from the Ember team. (since 2025-11-26; source handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer)
  - earlier: The image resizer is owned by the Ember team. (held 2025-03-20 to 2025-11-26; source handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer)
  - earlier: team Dune owns the image resizer. (held 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-20; source standup/dune/2025-01-20)
- Team Dune observed that the indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. (since 2026-06-09; source standup/dune/2026-06-09)
- The Boreal team observed that the product catalog's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. (since 2026-03-20; source standup/boreal/2026-03-20-2)
- The Atlas team observed that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change. (since 2025-12-25; source standup/atlas/2025-12-25)
- [decision] As of 2025-09-02, clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds. (since 2025-09-02; source standup/atlas/2025-09-02)
- [decision] Certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, a follow-up decision from the INC-2025-017 review. (since 2025-08-07; source incident-review/INC-2025-017)
- [decision] The product catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table. (since 2025-04-17; source standup/cinder/2025-04-17)
- INC-2025-023 was an indexer incident on 2025-10-03 in which the indexer served stale results for two days. (since 2025-10-07; source incident-review/INC-2025-023)
- The Boreal team noticed that the product catalog's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the product catalog's owners. (since 2026-06-04; source standup/boreal/2026-06-04)
- Team Dune observed that the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. (since 2025-03-26; source standup/dune/2025-03-26)
- The Atlas team observed that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change. (since 2026-04-16; source standup/atlas/2026-04-16)
- [decision] As of 2025-12-18, the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, since incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes. (since 2025-12-18; source standup/atlas/2025-12-18)
- [decision] The job scheduler's leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, a follow-up decision from the INC-2026-009 review. (since 2026-05-19; source incident-review/INC-2026-009)
- [decision] As of 2026-05-27, the bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. (since 2026-05-27; source standup/atlas/2026-05-27)
- The security audit flagged long-lived tokens. (since 2026-01-30; source standup/cinder/2026-01-30)
- [decision] As of 2026-01-30, the Cinder team agreed that auth gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. (since 2026-01-30; source standup/cinder/2026-01-30)

Question: Why does image-resizer keep original uploads for only 90 days?

message.content: Because storage for originals doubled in six months.
